[[Lady/Legends|Lady]] '''Siyanna Kaelish''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] individual who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateEntertainer.png|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Lady Siyanna Kaelish, including one male depiction deemed non-canon in ''Legends'']]
Siyanna Kaelish was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Siyanna Kaelish spawned under the generic "entertainer" template, her appearance was randomized under one of three possible depictions. She could either appear as a [[Human/Legends|Human]] female, a male [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]], or a female Twi'lek. The [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Kaelish as female, however the [[canon]]ical species cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
